title: Placement Process
content: The placement process at SRM is managed by the Career Centre. Eligible students must register with the Career Centre portal in their pre-final year (usually 6th semester). The process includes: 1. Career Guidance and Pre-Placement Training (PPT) covering aptitude, coding, communication skills, and mock interviews. 2. Company visits are announced on the portal, listing eligibility criteria (like minimum CGPA of 6.0/7.0, no standing backlogs). 3. Interested and eligible students apply for specific job profiles. 4. Recruitment rounds involve online assessment tests (aptitude, technical MCQs, coding challenges), followed by group discussions (GD) or technical interviews, and finally HR interviews. 5. Selected students receive offer letters. Under the 'One Student, One Job' policy, once a student is placed in a mass recruitment or core company, they are only eligible to apply for super-dream or dream companies offering significantly higher compensation.
